meta.what: naive-Bayes story-type weights learned from the labelled 12,033-article corpus
meta.features: tokens of [Telugu letters|ZW] or 2+ Latin letters, ZWNJ/ZWJ removed, lower-cased; headline x3, first 60 body words x1; plus a 4-letter prefix feature for non-ASCII tokens longer than 4
meta.held_out: top-1 0.679, top-3 0.828 on a 20% split; per-type precision is high for the big desks and low for small formats, so detect_type trusts it only for RELIABLE types with a margin
